description: This file defines an interface for S3 use ARN region configuration settings, specifying methods for checking ARN region usage and converting configuration to an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface for S3 ARN region configuration, requiring methods to determine if ARN region usage is enabled and to export the configuration as an array.

methods.name: isUseArnRegion
methods.description: Returns whether or not to use the ARN region if it differs from the client.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
